title: The Lunch Mat with No Neighbor
youtube_title: The Lunch Mat with No Neighbor | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Kito is just outside the fun, close to a lunch mat set apart from the row. Remy changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Kito has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
